subject.title: fix(deepinfra): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should an explicit `models.providers.deepinfra.request.allowPrivateNetwork: true` authorize DeepInfra video-generation HTTP requests, matching the shared provider request-policy contract used by other transports?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent with the shared resolver and has targeted transport proof, but extending an opt-in that can reach private network destinations is an operator-security boundary that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept policy parity
options.body: Approve the PR so DeepInfra video generation honors the existing sanitized request policy, including explicit private-network opt-in, proxy routing, and headers.

options.title: Keep video isolated
options.body: Retain the current hard private-network denial for this capability and document why video generation must differ from the shared provider policy.

recommendation.title: Accept policy parity
recommendation.body: Approve the PR so DeepInfra video generation honors the existing sanitized request policy, including explicit private-network opt-in, proxy routing, and headers.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available low-confidence routing candidate for a provider-policy security-boundary decision.
